title: Codex thread discovery can re-import an orphaned thread from a failed thread/start
outcome: A Codex thread/start that errors or times out can leave a thread on disk that startup discovery re-imports as a phantom, unlinked top-level session (no parentDelegationId). Remaining windows: thread/start timeout (id never learned) and persist failure (suppression needs the commit_locked that just failed). Fix: record the pending thread/start for kill/detach reconciliation, or give reviewer children a Codex home outside the discovery scopes. Ref import_discovered_codex_threads.
